settings.name: Sasquatch
settings.blurb: Runs the drum roaster over a real fire, one small batch at a time. Insists the forest air is the secret ingredient.
settings.dialogue:
Welcome to the forest.
We roast every batch over the perfect fire.
Nature Calls. Coffee Answers.

settings.name: Ollie
settings.blurb: Beakers, brew charts, and a suspicious number of empty cups. Every roast passes through Ollie's lab first.
settings.dialogue:
I tested this roast 143 times.
Science says: another cup.
Trust the process.

settings.name: Yeti
settings.blurb: Crates in, crates out. Keeps the shelves stocked, the clipboard updated, and the whole camp running on time.
settings.dialogue:
Crates in, crates out. All day.
Inventory is looking good today.
Mind the fresh stack!

settings.name: Mothman
settings.blurb: Keeps the campfire burning and the roasting schedule on track while the rest of the forest sleeps.
settings.dialogue:
I keep the campfire burning.
Roast schedule is on track.
The night is cozy out here.

settings.name: Jackalope
settings.blurb: Knows every trail through the camp. Point at any shelf and the Jackalope will hop you straight to it.
settings.dialogue:
This way to the good stuff!
Follow my footprints.
Hop hop — let us explore!

settings.title: The Origin
settings.body: It started with a single sack of green beans and a fire that wouldn't quit. Sasquatch roasted through the night; the forest woke up to the smell of it.

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.body: Premium, small-batch coffee roasted over the perfect fire — and shared with anyone who wanders down the trail.

settings.title: Coffee Philosophy
settings.body: Slow roasts, honest sourcing, and a deep respect for the woods that raised us. Ollie insists on testing every batch. Repeatedly.

settings.name: Simon
settings.blurb: Official Explorer and Coffee Quality Inspector. The face of Sasquatch Coffee since day one — give him a spin.
settings.dialogue:
Every legend needs a sidekick.
Official Explorer. Coffee Quality Inspector.
Welcome to Sasquatch Coffee!

settings.title: Happiness Guarantee
settings.text: Love it or we'll make it right

settings.question: How fresh is the coffee?
settings.answer: Every bag is roasted to order in small batches and shipped within 1–2 days — never off a warehouse shelf.

settings.question: How fast do you ship?
settings.answer: Orders roast and ship within 1–2 business days, with free shipping over $45. You'll get tracking the moment it leaves the roastery.

settings.question: Which grind should I choose?
settings.answer: Whole bean for the freshest cup, or pick your brewer's grind at checkout. Ollie recommends coarse for cold brew, standard for drip.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: If you're not happy with your roast, reach out and we'll make it right — a refund or a replacement. That's the camp promise.
